analyzed_vuln.description: `parse_data_sgroup()` repeatedly parses colon-delimited fields using `read_text_to()` and then unconditionally increments the iterator (`++first`) after each field. It does this even when the delimiter was not found and `first` is already at `last`. That advances the iterator past end, and subsequent `read_text_to()`/character checks dereference an invalid iterator, causing the heap-buffer-overflow read seen in `read_text_to()`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when CXSMILES `SgD:` data-sgroup text is malformed/truncated so one or more expected `:` separators (or trailing fields) are missing. Input reaches this via Mol block property parsing (`ParseMarvinSmartsLine` -> `SmartsToMol` -> `parseCXExtensions` -> `parse_it` -> `parse_data_sgroup`). The parser accepts `SgD:` prefix and atom list, then missing delimiters cause `parse_data_sgroup` to do unchecked `++first` at end, propagating an out-of-range iterator into later parsing and OOB read.
